cycles.note: First review since publication (2026-06-05). Whole skill treated as the diff. Phase 5.7 ran on a narrow Hebrew-only description change: the legal gate's F1 remedy replaced 'פסק דין מנומק' with 'מסקנת אימות מנומקת' ('פסק דין' reads as a judicial ruling). No trigger surface was added or removed and the English description is byte-identical to HEAD. Shipped as 1.1.1: the legal gate's R4 (face-search prohibition) was applied after the 1.1.0 tag was cut, and the Sigstore attestation is keyed by file digest, so the content was re-tagged rather than left attesting a stale digest.
lessons: Expert MAJOR deferred: add scripts/extract_audio.py (ffmpeg to WAV + ffprobe container/codec dump + optional spectrogram). The audio lane is the fastest-growing attack and is the only lane with no runnable support; all three scripts serve the image/video lane.

Expert MINOR deferred: extract_frames.py still uses the deprecated -vsync vfr (should be -fps_mode vfr), hardcodes gt(scene,0.4) with no --scene-threshold flag, and has no I-frame-only mode (-skip_frame nokey), which is usually the better first pass on a heavily recompressed WhatsApp forward.

Expert MINOR deferred (needs an admin decision, not a content edit): category is government-services for what is really a media-forensics skill, and supported_agents lists nine shell-capable agents with no platform agents (claude-ai, claude-desktop, chatgpt, gemini-spark). Step 1.3 now writes a full no-shell path, so the audience exists but cannot reach it. Consider security-compliance or communication plus the platform agents next cycle.

Deferred over the Phase 4.1 discretionary cap: C2PA published spec v2.3 (Feb 2026) and the Conformance Program's public Conforming Products List, which would give the existing 'a manifest is only as good as its signer' instruction a lookup mechanism beyond --certs.

Deferred, unverifiable this cycle: reports that Nikon shipped C2PA on the Z6 III and then suspended its Authenticity Service after a vulnerability. No Nikon-owned source found, so nothing was written. Re-check next cycle; if confirmed it belongs in the signer-trust discussion.

Deferred, could not verify from a primary source: the 105 hotline's WhatsApp line and the National Cyber Directorate's online cyber-event report URL. Both are plausible and would improve routing for users who will not phone, but gov.il refused every plain fetch and the shared Playwright browser was being hijacked by sibling agents. Verify and add next cycle.

Process lesson for the next cycle: the shared Playwright MCP returned another agent's DOM under the requested URL twice during this update (a kolzchut page and a yad2 form). The location.href assertion caught both. One of them would have produced a false 'snippet not found' on the Google Earth source. Never read the DOM without asserting href first.

Legal gate R5 deferred: move the 'not a forensic certification' exclusion from the END of both descriptions to the FRONT, so it survives card, search and OG truncation (consumer-knowledge point under חוק הגנת הצרכן §4(א)). Not applied this cycle because it is a real description rewrite on the routing surface, unlike the one-noun F1 swap, and it deserves its own holdout run. The gate itself marked it low severity and NOT required, since no reserved profession applies.

Judge caught the citation-overreach pattern worth repeating: the Veo page supports lip-sync (audio is generated jointly) but says nothing about BLINK. The fix was to split the claim, keeping lip-sync as sourced and marking blink explicitly as inference from the same mechanism. When retiring a class of tells, check the source covers every member of the class.

Judge also caught that the gov.il 105 page never mentions AI, though the skill's reference-links row claimed an 'AI impersonation' remit. Reworded to the hotline's published scope (online harm to minors). Watch for scope inflation when routing a new harm type to an existing hotline.

Removed rather than sourced, and worth revisiting if a citation turns up: Google's 'About this image' as a no-tooling C2PA check (would be genuinely useful for the no-shell user), and the claim that classic Google search-by-image now redirects to Lens.
